name: zenmoney-mcp-ddvin
description: Access ZenMoney personal finance data — accounts, categories, transactions, transfers.
long_description: MCP server for ZenMoney. Sync accounts, browse categories and merchants, list/filter transactions over arbitrary date ranges, add expenses/income, transfer between accounts (including cross-currency), delete transactions (expenses, income, transfers, debts) and accounts/categories/merchants, and auto-suggest categories for known payees.

tools.name: sync_data
tools.description: Refresh data from ZenMoney on demand (other tools sync automatically).

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List wallets, cards, and cash accounts.

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: List and filter transactions (supports arbitrary date ranges).

tools.name: delete_transaction
tools.description: Delete transactions — expenses, income, transfers, debts.

tools.name: delete_object
tools.description: Delete an account, a category, or a merchant.

tools.name: suggest_category
tools.description: Suggest a category for a given payee.
